title: Rav Ada son of Rav Yitzchak, or bar Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yoma 17a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.17a.2); [Beitzah 19b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.19b.4); [Gittin 28a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.28a.14) (resolving Abaye’s difficulty, with Rav Papa challenging him); [Zevachim 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.38a.11) (from which Hyman infers that he lived in Rava’s time); [Zevachim 111a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.111a.4); and [Menachot 5a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.5a.6).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Zevachim passages give the shorter form bar Yitzchak and the fuller bar Rav Yitzchak. Beitzah gives an alternative attribution to Shmuel bar Abba. Gittin names Ada as the one answering and Papa as the one challenging that answer. See [Heilprin’s corresponding entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=211&lang=en).
